summary: security lens over composed-relation (13 product path(s), e5ae835..a66404d, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 0 non-blocking. The new grant checks cover the action, domain, and selected fields, but the composed relation does not apply the user's plant authorization to the DUB-only Budget source. This creates a concrete cross-scope financial-data disclosure for otherwise authorized users whose plant scope excludes DUB.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Enforce DUB scope before exposing Budget rows (backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:118): The Budget CTE is unconditional, so a user with the required action/object grants but whose validated plant scope contains only another plant (for example, LON) still receives DUB Budget data.
